permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Replace only with an equivalent CI gate that proves the retired runtime is never invoked.
permanentExceptions.rationale: The Node CI installs a failing sentinel executable and proves that no gate invokes the retired runtime.

permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Remove when generic command validation no longer supports external projects using this package manager.
permanentExceptions.rationale: The generic command validator recognizes package-manager commands requested for external repositories.

permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Replace only when another fail-closed validator enforces the same repository policy.
permanentExceptions.rationale: The fail-closed policy validator necessarily names every forbidden runtime surface it detects.

permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Remove together with the policy validator only after equivalent regression coverage exists.
permanentExceptions.rationale: The policy validator regression suite contains inert fixture strings proving that active runtime globals and imports are rejected.

permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Remove when publication validation no longer supports external repositories selecting this package manager.
permanentExceptions.rationale: Publication validation must run the package manager and test command declared by each external target repository.

permanentExceptions.removalCondition: Remove when runtime gates no longer inspect external repositories using this package manager.
permanentExceptions.rationale: The runtime gate detects package-manager metadata in external repositories and fails closed on ambiguous locks.
